003.text: Rin Satsuki has beaten Remilia Scarlet.

012.name: Remilia
012.text: You took to long to stop the ritual.

013.name: Remilia
013.text: The moon is at it's zenith.

014.name: Remilia
014.text: The spell is impossible to reverse at this point.

015.name: Remilia
015.text:
We'll need to wait a few days before the moon 
			retreats on it's own.

017.name: Rin
017.text: But you can romise that it will return to normal, right?

018.name: Remilia
018.text: Vampires are many things, but we aren't liars.

019.name: Rin
019.text:
I guess it's time I head back to the village then.
			There are probably plenty of people who would get sick 
			in the meantime.

020.name: Remilia
020.text:
About that, don't you think you should worry about yourself first?
			This mist does some unpleasant things to humans, and you are right
			in its center.

023.name: Remilia
023.text: Oh, it might be too late for you.

025.name: Remilia
025.text:
Sorry, I don't think there's anything we can do for 
			you at this stage.

028.name: Remilia
028.text: You were a nice human, Rin. I was nice meeting you.

030.name: Remilia
030.text: I won't forget you, at least for a couple of centuries.

034.name: Remilia
034.text: Sakuya, please clean her up quickly.

035.name: Remilia
035.text: I want my next meal to be as fresh as it can be.

039.text:
Try for a Single Credit Clear for the true end!
			Or move on to the Extra Stage to continue the story.
